item.text: The config loader already runs authentication validation during `config.Load`, so startup will reject invalid settings at the right point. GitHub currently checks only `read:org`, and OIDC has no provider checks; I’m adding provider-qualified field errors and making those checks run before session-domain validation can mask them.
